companyProfile.companyDescription: Infosys Limited is an India-based company which provides digital services and consulting. The Company enables clients in approximately 63 countries to navigate their digital transformation powered by cloud and artificial intelligence (AI). Its segments include Financial Services; Retail; Communication; Energy, Utilities, Resources and Services; Manufacturing; Hi-Tech; Life Sciences, and All other segments. The Company's solutions have been primarily classified as digital and core. Its digital solutions include experience, insight, innovate, accelerate, and assure. Its experience solutions include Infosys Aster, Digital Marketing, Digital Commerce and Infosys Metaverse Foundry. Its insight solutions include Infosys Topaz, Infosys Generative AI Labs, Data Analytics and AI, Infosys Sustainability Services and Applied AI. Its core solutions include application management services, proprietary application development services, traditional enterprise application implementation and others.

recentNews.headline: Mint Quick Edit | What global tech-stock volatility says about AI-prompted market speculation
recentNews.summary: Asian stock markets have been shaken lately, with chipmaker stocks like SK Hynix on a sharp slide. The shares of Indian IT service companies like TCS and Infosys seem in recovery mode, meanwhile. Signs of a rebalance?

recentNews.headline: Cognizant outpaces TCS, Infosys; stock takes off despite demand gloom
recentNews.summary: Cognizant cut its guidance for the year to at best 5.9%, the lowest outlook since the final quarter of 2024, underlining the demand challenge over the broader IT services sector.

recentNews.headline: TCS vs Infosys vs Wipro vs HCL Tech: Which IT stock to buy after Q1 results?
recentNews.summary: Infosys share price emerged as top gainer, surged as much as 4.79%. Meanwhile, TCS, Wipro and HCL Tech shares surged over 2% during the intraday session on 29 July.

recentNews.headline: Coforge, Infosys to TCS: IT stocks rally as US software stocks outperform SOX last night; Nifty IT index jumps around 3%
recentNews.summary: IT stocks, including TCS, Infosys, and HCLTech, surged on July 28, boosted by positive US market trends. The Nifty IT index rose approximately 3%, continuing a two-day gain. Key players like Coforge and Mphasis performed particularly well, reflecting a revival in investor sentiment.

recentNews.headline: Student expectations of the Nikelani panel are high but education needs far more than exam reforms
recentNews.summary: A new panel headed by Infosys chairman Nandan Nilekani has raised hopes of this sector’s reform. Yet, India faces such steep challenges that it’s likely nothing short of a system-wide overhaul will do. Here are some cues for consideration.

recentNews.headline: Top Gainers & Losers on 27 July: CarTrade Tech, Laurus Labs, Infosys, Atul, TBO Tek, Anant Raj among top gainers
recentNews.summary: The Indian stock market rebounded on July 27, with benchmark indices rising about 1% as crude oil prices fell due to reduced tensions in the Middle East. Broad-based sector gains were seen, spurred by Nifty Media, IT, and Realty, reversing a recent downturn.

recentNews.headline: Top Gaines & Losers on 24 July: Syrma SGS Tech, HFCL, Swiggy, Eternal, Hero MotoCorp among top losers
recentNews.summary: The Indian stock market fell for the fifth consecutive session, with the Nifty 50 closing at 23,767 and the Sensex at 76,408. Weaker earnings from Infosys and IndiGo, along with escalating geopolitical tensions, contributed to the decline, marking the worst weekly performance in four months.

recentNews.headline: Infosys' weak Q1 raises the risk of another year of lagging peers
recentNews.summary: Weak revenue growth, a guidance cut and softer deal wins have raised concerns over Infosys' FY27 outlook, while AI-led pricing pressure threatens to widen its gap with larger peers.

recentNews.headline: Why Infosys picked Dash: AI bets, continuity and the search for stability
recentNews.summary: Infosys’ decision to name company veteran Ashiss Dash as its next CEO is a bet on continuity and AI leadership to navigate an uncertain future for IT services.

recentNews.headline: Infosys share price falls 2.5% after guidance cut, new CEO announcement during Q1 results: buy, sell or hold?
recentNews.summary: Infosys reported a 12.3% YoY net profit increase for Q1 FY27, but shares fell 2.5% after lowering FY27 revenue guidance. New CEO Ashiss Kumar Dash will start on April 1, 2027. Brokerage firm Motilal Oswal maintains a buy call with a target price of ₹1,170.
